title: Structured essay (machine/memory version)
description: The structured-prompt-style output of /api/read. JSON-native so the UI can render numbered findings with page cites without parsing markdown, and so the structured output can feed later passes deterministically.

title.description: Names what the lens has just shown. Not a topic label; a thesis fragment.

lens_restatement.description: One paragraph: the clause restated in the model's own words, so we can audit drift.

quote.description: Verbatim Bataille — must be quotable from the book.txt the model read.

lens_relation.description: How this finding confirms / complicates / refutes the lens.

items.description: One declarative sentence each; new conclusions this lens has produced. Must not be tautological with the lens itself.
Questions the lens raises that this pass did not answer. Seeds for next research.

research_seeds.description: ⊕ seeds — what should be sent to the background researcher.
